judgements.reason: Losing self-respect over fishing; trivial beside betrayal guilt.
About being cheated and laughing; wrong angle and flippant here.
Image of dying in sleep in snow; unsafe for someone not wanting to live.
Frames the past as making death difficult; risky for this person.
Letting go of resentment toward others, not self-forgiveness.
Names remorse accurately but offers no way through it.
Watch your own faults; may deepen self-scrutiny rather than ease it.
Choosing to live rather than endlessly atone; a useful angle.
Forgiven past sins wake the heart from despair and 'I cannot'.
Anguish lifted; sins cast behind God's back. Directly addresses unforgiven guilt.
Self-scourging over a habit; mirrors the pain without relief.
About excusing sin; this person already owns it fully.
Grief for a dead friend; off-topic.
Forlorn mood matches loosely; nothing on guilt or forgiveness.
Doing good without seeking credit; unrelated.
Sorrow helps one grow; vague for self-condemnation.
Confession, repentance and mercy; though 'grieve as long as I live' may weigh.
Dawn near despite midnight; gentle hope for someone feeling unworthy.
Friendships outgrown; unrelated.
Wrongdoer harms himself; too terse and could read as condemning.
Forgiving others' hurts; not about forgiving oneself.
'You left your first love' would land as accusation.
Guilty pleasures leave regret; true but adds weight more than relief.
Chose to live for others; sometimes living takes courage.
Wronged a loved one yet was forgiven and remade.
Taking blame one does not owe; mirrors misplaced self-blame.
Implies hidden guilt; wrong for someone wronged.
Spirit like the wind; unrelated.
Says the fault is yours for trusting; blames the person.
Loving wrongdoers; premature and beside the self-blame.
Their conduct is their business, not yours; eases self-blame.
Steadiness in storms; generic.
About whom to trust; misses the self-blame.
Calls trust lazy and vain; would land as blame.
Betrayal of confidence; different breach, no self-blame angle.
Thinking for oneself; unrelated.
World as mirage; unrelated.
Keep going, don't despair; generic.
Suffering leads to confusion; touches rumination only loosely.
Letting oneself be wronged to laugh; jarring here.
Walk on, don't linger; faint fit for rumination.
Broken trust breeding misanthropy; not their concern.
Don't hand your mind to others; 'ashamed' tone fits poorly.
Not lending oneself to wrong; could imply complicity.
Being hard to admonish; unrelated.
Stop dragging memory's corpse; loosely touches replaying the past.
Self-trust; generic.
Trusted friend turned against me; names the betrayal, not self-doubt.
Natural vs false desires; unrelated.
Others' opinions don't matter; misses the point.
Contentment and never being forsaken; speaks to lack and fear.
Being cheated of money buys prudence; unrelated.
Milestones prized from afar prove smaller; reframes the measure.
'Tomorrow will be like today' may confirm the bleak fear.
Years without knowing the next meal, yet needs came.
All is fleeting; general and a bit bleak.
No unjust success; off-target.
Steadfastness amid loss; not about feeling stalled.
Old age shedding desires; loosely relevant.
Craving the future comes from not yet finding oneself.
Money won't satisfy; beside the point.
Lonely toil is vanity; bleak, not helpful.
Asking why I am the one left poor; voices the 'is this it'.
Money breeds craving; off-target.
Facts versus our judgement of them; reframes the list of lacks.
Real help comes from within; a call to self-reliance.
Present self is a passing stage; perspective on a milestone.
Waiting for a guiding companion; loose.
Don't plan far; the future is unowned. Partial fit.
Death may come anywhere; unsuitable on a low birthday.
Early failure isn't ruin; the one who keeps trying has a hundred chances.
Debt to parents; tangential to living at home.
Others have plenty, I seem to have lost everything; deeply resonant.
Youthful expectations seed disappointment; explains the feeling.
Wants never rest; generic.
Travel doesn't cure gloom; they aren't fleeing gloom.
Troubles follow you; off-target.
Fear leaving familiar shelter; the old abides in the new, strangers become kin.
Our fates aren't fixed by fences; the world is wider.
Don't forsake friends; near neighbour; partly relevant but slanted.
Friends taken in affliction; wrong situation.
Presenting oneself wrongly; unrelated.
Cherish friends while we have them; weighs what is being left.
Forgotten by friends; bleak and off-target.
Exile longs for home; heightens fear, offers little.
The heart magnifies distance; gentle perspective.
Turning the other cheek; unrelated.
Call to leave country and kin for a new land; the archetype of this choice.
Travel won't fix inner troubles; not their issue.
Rebuke for evil done; unrelated.
Renouncing the world; unrelated.
Against restless moving; loose and slightly discouraging.
Pain of a broken habit of living together; tangential.
Presence counts wherever you are; eases the wrong-place fear.
Don't care about friends or fame; jars with their values.
Happiness and misery alternate; generic.
The poor shunned by friends; unrelated.
Travel with wise friends or alone; loose.
Family, friends and home matter most for happiness; helps weigh the move.
Change costs old ties; different context.
Christ among outcasts; unrelated.
How to love country, wife and father through storms; fits family priority.
Wish to die at home; mentions death, only loosely relevant.
Family separating peacefully; tangential.
Leaving homeland for a new land; mirrors the move.
Love needs no why; vague here.
Teaching the ignorant; unrelated.
Titles and riches mislead; loosely on job allure.
Family trouble taken on for love; indirect.
Going abroad for fortune is a detour; partial fit.
Friends dying far away; unsuitable.
East or West, home is best; speaks to the pull of home.
Honest livelihood supports family; generic.
Contentment without needing place; loose.
Leave wife and child when called; clashes with their values.
Work for others before home; off-target.
Live as a sojourner; loose.
You only know a new land by living there; eases fear of the unknown.
Who you are matters more than where; the world is your country.
Devotional prayer; unrelated.
Training the mind; unrelated.
Fear of change; loosely relevant.
Life is trial either way; generic.
Change of soul over climate; loose.
Choosing ecstasy over power; faint parallel.
Forgiveness of sins; unrelated.
Afraid to choose, the suspense hurt more; names the paralysis.
Soul and mind waves; unrelated.
Poverty that enjoys true wealth; favours meaning.
Happy on small salary, sad on large; money isn't the measure.
Singing over busyness; slight.
Brother's injustice; unrelated.
Grief for a friend; unrelated.
The best chooses me; eases pressure to pick perfectly.
Hard choices between painful options; validates the difficulty.
Work that misfits your powers makes life unhappy; weighs the soul-crushing job.
All prisoners awaiting death; unsuitable.
Brother's injustice; unrelated.
Turning the other cheek; unrelated.
Livelihoods can be profitable and good; slight.
Spending your best years earning to live later; speaks directly to the trade-off.
Choosing both worlds; loose.
Money won't satisfy; generic.
Hope for wealth is hard to drop; thin.
Two wills at war; loose parallel to being torn.
Fair-weather friends; unrelated.
Life or wealth, which is dearer; frames the choice.
Wealth won't sustain you; partial.
Oneness ends fear; abstract and off-target.
Nature never promised we'd never look foolish; directly eases fear of exposure.
Keep your composure; misses the inner fraud feeling.
Sorrow turned to joy; unrelated.
Selves change from child to adult; loose.
Outer vessel vs contents; loosely about appearances.
Adults are children ruled by forms; tangential.
Everyone dies; unrelated.
Sorrow died; unrelated.
Preparation beats panic; 'unschooled boy' may sting.
Kinship across races; unrelated.
Rebuke for talking big; wrong and harsh.
Anxiety about what others say drives much trouble; names the fear.
Taught weakness, slowly realising one's strength; relevant.
Neither child nor grown; faint echo.
Warns against overrating powers; would feed self-doubt.
Showing talent as substitute for worth; reads as accusing.
You choose to fall short; condemning tone.
We all change masks; partly relevant but demanding.
Too confident; opposite of their problem.
Moments of calm and the Infinite; unrelated.
Be content to seem foolish; others' esteem isn't the point.
Accept seeming foolish; distrust being thought important.
Comfort as a mother comforts; tender but generic.
Lone correct watch; unrelated.
We change from child to adult; loose.
Ambition sees only who is ahead; explains the feeling.
Craving new thoughts; unrelated.
Fame buried like sand; loose.
Turn eyes away from what stirs craving; practical for the chat.
Be not afflicted; no one can say what you have left to do.
Liking one's likes; off-target.
Feelings as guests that come and go; answers 'what do I do with this feeling'.
Attend to what you feel, not what others suggest; reframes.
Many ahead, think of those behind; you have outstripped yourself.
Patience; rise again; encouraging.
Worry over opinion; partial.
Keep old friends; off-target.
Thinking equal, better or worse breeds strife; on comparison.
Others' promotions torment if you prize status; imaginary poverty from comparison.
Rejoice for those preferred, or don't grieve; on others' gains.
Fear of being nobody; be somebody in what's yours.
Death denial; unrelated.
Devotional surrender; unrelated.
Others feast, I alone seem lost; mirrors being left behind.
Don't boast of gifts received; tangential.
Equanimity to praise and blame; loose.
False sentiment everywhere; unrelated.
Drop old assumptions; loose.
Fear of being nobody; matter in what's in your power.
Comparison torments; enjoy your own lot. Direct answer.
